name: dashboard-ai-boilerplate
description: Boilerplate dashboard admin ber-AI — API-first, SSR, modular, database-agnostic, self-hosted

scripts.bootstrap: bun run db:codegen && bun run modules:sync && bun run db:codegen
scripts.build: bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.check: bun run bootstrap && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.ci:sync-pure: bun run bootstrap && git diff --exit-code && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)"
scripts.db:generate: bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd packages/db generate
scripts.db:matrix: docker compose --profile matrix up -d --wait && bun run scripts/db-matrix.ts
scripts.db:matrix:docker: docker compose --profile matrix up -d --wait && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e MATRIX_MYSQL_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e MATRIX_MARIADB_URL=mysql://app:app@mariadb:3306/app -e MATRIX_POSTGRES_URL=postgres://app:app@postgres:5432/app oven/bun:1.4 bun run scripts/db-matrix.ts
scripts.scheduler:proof:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app oven/bun:1.4 bun run scripts/scheduler-proof.ts
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e INTEGRATION=1 oven/bun:1.4 sh -c "bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd packages/db migrate && bun test integration"
